not_authorised: any analysis before B19L's runner, which is already pinned
any change to B19L or its runner after collection begins
reuse of window 1's directory under any circumstance
authorised_next_step.step_1: commit this document alone, before any chain or RPC query
authorised_next_step.step_2: re-attest the script manifest, since the collection path changed
authorised_next_step.step_3: peer review of the collection path and this document
authorised_next_step.step_4: start the supervisor, which waits for maturity and then runs the frozen ten-stage pipeline into research/b11m_window2

derivation.endpoints_are_derived_never_restated: successor_ranges() computes window 1's endpoints from the register that produced them rather than repeating them as literals, which is how a second copy of a geometry drifts from its source
derivation.rule: identical to B11A: start one slot after the maximum inclusive burned endpoint, carry the B8b launch span and the B9d observation span unchanged
derivation.what_changed: window 1's FULL OBSERVATION SPAN is now in the burned register, so the same arithmetic places this window after it

frozen_window.disjointness_scope: checked for BOTH the launch window and the full observation span, against every range INCLUDING window 1

geometry_inheritance: spans inherited from B8b and B9d through B11A unchanged. No span was chosen with any knowledge of window 1's outcomes.

observation_maturity.estimated_maturity: approximately 2026-08-16, from 2.3934 slots/s, which is an ESTIMATE and never a commitment. The gate is the tip, not the clock.
observation_maturity.rule: no stage that reads the observation span may run until the chain's finalized tip is at or beyond the observation cutoff. The supervisor waits; it does not truncate.
observation_maturity.the_launches_already_exist: the launch window has already passed on chain; it is the observation span that must age. Collecting before it matures would truncate exits and is refused.

prohibited_inferences: no outcome of window 1 may motivate any choice here; every span and threshold is inherited
no inspection of this window's contents beyond what enumeration and collection mechanically require
no model, signal or baseline is fitted during collection
nothing signs, submits or spends; no wallet or key exists anywhere in this work
purpose: collect the second fresh window, so B19L can test a frozen exit family out-of-sample on data that did not exist when the family was frozen. Window 1 is contaminated for that test: B19K's take-profit levels descend from ceiling quantiles and its author had seen the fresh-window headroom table before freezing.
regime: classified AFTER collection against markers frozen in B19L, never by waiting. Waiting for an undefined marker is discretion wearing patience's name.

work_directory.must_not_be_window_1: b11c.assert_work_dir_belongs_to refuses a generation configured to write into another's directory, and refuses again when a directory holds a state whose recorded cutoff differs from the derived one. Window 1's artifacts stand behind three spent ledger passes and cannot be recollected.
